schemas.leads: canonical lead state owned through Leads-Workstation service
schemas.lead_ops: import batches, immutable row-provenance manifest, governed promotion candidates, duplicate review, outbox/operational metadata

invariants: country and business_category are distinct non-derived columns
Meltano role cannot write canonical leads schema
n8n has no direct canonical database writer role
migration and restore paths are replayable
raw staging cannot be promoted directly into canonical leads
promotion candidates require explicit review/approval and Leads API validation before canonical write
real-batch canonical promotion requires import-batch promotion_authorized=true
promotion candidates must reference an exact staged-row provenance manifest entry
leads_importer may append row provenance but cannot write promotion decisions or canonical leads
